acceptance_criteria.criterion: Cross-store knowledge queries with limit/offset apply pagination to the merged result set, not per-store.
Per-store calls still receive scope, repository_name, category, and tags filters for efficient filtering.
When limit is 5 and store A has 3 matching insights and store B has 4, the result contains 5 insights (not 3 + 4 = 7, not min(3,5) + min(4,5)).
offset correctly skips across the merged set.
